parent_feature.title: Project Foundation And Motion App Shell

notes: Small features must be added here before implementation starts.
Keep this file focused on Project Foundation And App Shell only.
Read feature_tasks/2.json, the Interface Design handoff artifacts, and the initial web page prototypes before implementing this feature.
Feature 3 should turn the static/prototype app-shell pages from Feature 2 into a functional project foundation and motion-first workspace context.

Feature 3 must replace shallow static card layouts with selected UI TripleD-style shadcn/Radix + Framer Motion adaptations where they fit: dashboard, project-card, workflow, account-settings, animated navigation, route transitions, and AI loading/progress states.
Feature 3 must include reduced-motion behavior, keyboard accessibility, text status labels, and verification that motion supports state comprehension instead of hiding functionality.

For unfinished functions or placeholders, do not write long descriptions directly into the main UI. Use concise labels and click-to-reveal detail such as a modal, drawer, popover, or expandable panel saying the function is not built yet or requires a later feature.

small_features.title: Select UI TripleD shadcn components patterns
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users see a coherent motion-first direction based on selected block families instead of generic static cards.
verification: Record the selected UI TripleD shadcn block/components names and where each maps in the product.
Verify Base UI variants are not selected unless architecture is updated.
evidence: Selected task 1-3 UI TripleD-style shadcn/Radix + Framer Motion patterns are recorded in sprint-contract.md and apps/web/src/app/workspace/workspace-data.ts as animated-navigation/app-shell, dashboard, and project-card.

Implemented local source mapping through WorkspaceShell, MotionShellHeader, MotionRouteFrame, MotionNavItem, DashboardMetricTile, ProjectMotionCard, MotionPatternDisclosure, and UnavailableDisclosure.

Workspace overview renders data-motion-pattern-map="selected-ui-tripled-shadcn-patterns" and only the task 1-3 pattern selections; workflow and AI generation-state adaptations remain later Feature 3 tasks.
No Base UI variant is selected; tests assert Radix shadcn local source and absence of Base UI.
small_features.notes: Task 1-3 selected only animated navigation/app-shell, dashboard, and project-card patterns. Workflow, account-settings, and AI generation-state block adaptations remain not_started in later tasks.

small_features.title: Implement motion-first app shell
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users enter a workspace shell with animated navigation, route/shell transitions, default project context, and clear workspace identity.
verification: Run web tests, typecheck, and build.
Rendered desktop and mobile QA must show route/shell transitions and no horizontal overflow.
evidence: Updated apps/web/src/app/workspace/workspace-components.tsx and added apps/web/src/app/workspace/workspace-motion.tsx so the shared workspace shell has Framer Motion route/header/nav wrappers while icon-bearing cards remain server-safe for static prerendering.

Workspace shell renders data-animation-runtime="framer-motion", data-motion-shell="framer-route-transition", data-animated-navigation="workspace-route-list", data-route-transition markers, reduced-motion fallback marker, active route state, and default local project context.
Backend and persistence boundaries remain visible through Prototype limits and local project context labels; no backend, persistence, model, queue, worker, or export API call was added.
Rendered QA against http://127.0.0.1:3004 confirmed desktop /workspace, mobile /workspace, and mobile /workspace/canvas had no console warnings/errors and no horizontal overflow.
small_features.notes: The motion wrappers are isolated in workspace-motion.tsx to avoid passing Lucide component functions into client components during Next static prerendering.

small_features.title: Upgrade workspace dashboard and project cards
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users see animated project, recent work, readiness, and metric surfaces based on richer UI TripleD dashboard/card patterns.
verification: Verify project/dashboard content is X-META-specific and not upstream demo content.
Verify hover, focus, selected, and reduced-motion behavior.
evidence: Updated /workspace to render Motion Workspace dashboard with animated dashboard metrics, readiness signals, and project cards for Neon alley comic pilot, Midnight chorus MV, and Vertical teaser pipeline.
Project cards include selected, hover/focus, motion-state, and reduced-motion markers plus compact click-to-reveal Project persistence missing disclosure.
Dashboard/project copy is X-META-specific and covers comic drama, MV creation, short-form video, node canvas, assets, task states, history, export, and backend boundaries.

Workspace route tests now cover the motion shell, selected UI TripleD mappings, animated dashboard metrics, project card states, reduced-motion markers, product-specific copy, and absence of generic chat/starter content.
small_features.notes: Dashboard/project cards are local examples only and do not imply saved projects or real task creation.

small_features.title: Upgrade workflow canvas presentation
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users see an animated node workflow surface with selected-node state, dependency direction, inspector transitions, and generation-state placeholders.
verification: Verify canvas/workflow route renders animated node and inspector states.
Verify text status labels remain present and motion does not replace state text.
small_features.notes: This is still not full drag/zoom execution unless Feature 4 scope is explicitly pulled in.

small_features.title: Add animated generation feedback states
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can distinguish queued, generating, succeeded, failed, and retryable states through motion plus readable labels.
verification: Verify loading/progress/success/failure/retry states exist in task or node surfaces.
Verify reduced-motion fallback and accessible status copy.
small_features.notes: Use AI loading/input/typing patterns where they fit.

small_features.title: Constrain unfinished function disclosure
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users see clean primary screens; unfinished actions reveal short 'not built yet' or 'requires later feature' messages only when clicked.
verification: Verify unfinished functions do not display long always-visible descriptions in the main page layout.
Verify each unavailable action has an accessible click-to-reveal explanation or clear disabled label.
Verify the explanation names the missing capability briefly and does not imply it already works.
small_features.notes: Use modal, drawer, popover, tooltip, or expandable detail depending on context. Keep visible copy compact.

small_features.title: Final verification and handoff
small_features.user_visible_behavior: The motion app shell is verified and documented as the new baseline for later canvas, node, backend, and export features.
small_features.notes: Do not mark passing without evaluator evidence.
